description: A script for performing source code transformations to create a new Long-Term Support (LTS) release, including string replacements and content stripping in configuration files.

methods.name: ReplaceStringsInFile
methods.description: Performs textual replacements in a specified file based on a provided dictionary.

methods.name: StripContentBetweenTags
methods.description: Removes all content between specified begin and end tags in a file, including the tags.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes command-line arguments and performs file modifications for LTS creation.
